  associated with recessive phenotypes by lowercase letters. Assume the genes are not found on a  
  sex chromosome. Indicate the color alleles as "B" and "b" the wing alleles by the letters "N" and "n".  
  a) The genotypes of the flies in the P generation are:  
  b) The genotype of the flies in the F1 generation is:  
  c) You count 1600 offspring in the F2 generation. If the wing and the color traits were linked and no  
  recombination occurred, you would expect to count:  
  d) When you count the F2 generation, you really get:  
  • 85 brown winged flies  
  • 728 black winged flies  
  • 712 brown wingless flies  
  • 75 black wingless flies  
  What is the genetic distance between the color and wing genes?
